'''Ice Rush''' requires a [[Magic]] level of 58 and can do a maximum of 16 damage (without any [[magic damage]] boosts) per cast.

Ice Rush can freeze targets, causing them to become unable to move for {{Ticks|8}}.

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

It is the weakest of the [[Ice spells]] and is thus likely to be ignored by a player with access to [[Ice Burst]] which, on top of dealing significantly more damage, is only marginally more expensive and is able to hit multiple targets with a single cast.

Unlike the rest of the Ice spells, Ice Rush does ''not'' benefit from the [[Ancient sceptre]]'s passive 10% [[freeze]] duration increase due to the calculation rounding down. It still benefits as usual from the [[Ice ancient sceptre]]'s 10% accuracy increase against unfrozen targets.
